question: Ishaan and Meghna have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Ishaan is driving at 77 km/hr while Meghna is driving at 33 km/hr. Find the time taken by Meghna to reach Kanpur if Ishaan takes 12 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Ratio of speeds (Ishaan : Meghna) = 77 : 33 = 7 : 3

Ratio of time taken (Ishaan : Meghna) = 3 : 7

Ishaan's time = 3 units = 12 hours ⇒ 1 unit = 4 hours

Meghna's time = 7 units = 7 × 4 = 28 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 28 hours.**
